paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Accuracy of Llama4 Scout (top) and Llama4 Maverick (bottom) on 5-digit multiplication.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the accuracy of two models, Llama4 Scout (top) and Llama4 Maverick (bottom), on 5-digit multiplication tasks, as a function of their initial confidence. The x-axis, labeled "Initial Confidence," is linear and ranges from 0.91 to 0.98, with tick marks at 0.01 intervals. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy," is also linear and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. The top line, representing Llama4 Scout, is a solid blue line with circular markers and error bars; it starts at approximately 0.85 accuracy at initial confidence 0.91, rises to about 1.0 at 0.92, and then remains nearly flat at 1.0 across the remaining confidence values. The bottom line, representing Llama4 Maverick, is a dashed green line with square markers and error bars; it begins at approximately 0.2 accuracy at 0.91, dips slightly to around 0.15 at 0.92, then gradually increases to about 0.8 at 0.98. Additionally, an orange dashed line with diamond markers and error bars is present, starting at approximately 0.6 at 0.91, peaking at around 0.9 at 0.92, and then steadily decreasing to about 0.1 at 0.98. All lines exhibit error bars indicating variability in the accuracy measurements.
